_comment: Canonical dinas codes RDT can route a transaction TO (dinas_target) — mirrors data_user/employee-directory.seed.json's 21-dinas PIC roster (TB..TU) plus 'TA' and 'Corp' (both real target values with no dedicated PIC — confirmed by role TAB only, same pattern as REQ-RDT-AUTH-04's Corp; see backend/sql/schema.sql's rdt.dinas seed). Deliberately does NOT include 'TAB' — that's the admin division running RDT itself, not an operational dinas that can receive a repost transaction (backend/sql/schema.sql's comment on rdt.dinas is explicit that TAB has no row there on purpose, so a dinas_target of 'TAB' fails the transactions_dinas_target_fkey constraint outright). 'TAB people confirm it' just means role TAB (which can act on ANY dinas via requireDinasAccess) — it does NOT mean the target value itself becomes 'TAB' (project owner correction, 28 Jul 2026, after 'TA'/'Ask TA' briefly resolved to 'TAB' and broke the FK on real repost). Used by excelParser.js so an exact code resolves even with no mapping.seed.json entry, and to detect GMF's sub-dinas naming convention — a real code plus extra trailing letters with no separator (e.g. dinas TM's own sub-unit written as 'TMM') — confirmed as a GMF-wide convention by the project owner, 28 Jul 2026.
